evidence: Verified the new defaults are non-zero and stoichiometrically derived: `crates/tank_core/src/types/process.rs:311-317` and `crates/tank_data/data/process/default.toml:13-22` set respiration/photosynthesis DIC rates to `0.01875` and `0.075` mg C/g/h.
Ran `cargo test --test budget_tracking --test budget_helpers --test microfauna_routing`: 45/45 tests passed.
Ran `cargo test --test co2_exchange --test dissolved_oxygen`: 17/17 tests passed.
findings_or_gaps: High: the required always-off planted regression is missing. `crates/tank_core/tests/photosynthesis_dic.rs:241-286` removes all plants/algae and only checks `no_plant_swing < planted_swing`; it does not run the same planted fixture with lights forced off, and it never asserts that DIC only increases from respiration over the full probe. A regression where planted biomass still perturbs pH/DIC in darkness would pass this suite.

Medium: the shipped-scenario integration probe is weaker than the bead acceptance criteria. `crates/tank_core/tests/photosynthesis_dic.rs:420-501` no longer asserts `end_of_light_pH > end_of_dark_pH` by at least `0.1` in a real scenario; it only checks that pH does not decline by more than `0.05` across one lit window and allows the broad storage bound `[5.5, 8.5]`. That leaves the requested day/night chemistry story for default scenarios unverified.

Medium: the photosynthesis stoichiometry test uses a 5% tolerance instead of the required 1%. `crates/tank_core/tests/photosynthesis_dic.rs:337-346` asserts `relative_error < 0.05`, so the acceptance criterion can still fail without the test catching it.
follow_up_or_amendments: Add a planted-fixture lights-off regression that keeps plant/algae biomass present, forces lights off for 48h, and asserts both negligible diurnal pH swing and non-decreasing DIC across the run.

Strengthen the shipped-scenario integration probe to measure end-of-light versus end-of-dark pH in the actual scenario path and enforce the requested `>= 0.1` separation if that remains the intended contract; if the current model cannot satisfy that because of the midnight growth sink, fix the model instead of weakening the assertion.
